caption: The drawing depicts a round plate set against a plain, off-white background. The plate features a central image with a brown deer in mid-leap, facing to the left. Below the deer, there is a striped animal resembling a tiger, colored in orange and brown with black stripes. To the right of the tiger-like animal, there is a green dog-like figure with a brown spot on its back. To the right side of the deer, there is a brown horse facing right, moving in the same direction as the deer. At the top of the plate, the words “Deer Chase” are written in cursive script. The edge of the plate is decorated with a border of scrolls, leaves, and floral elements in brown, orange, and green hues. The artist's name, E. N. Belladay, is written in green near the lower right side of the plate’s edge. The overall color palette includes browns, oranges, greens, and hints of yellow, with shading to add dimension to the figures.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
